description: Ranked ratings leaderboard — filter by band, score range, trend, or facet threshold. Sort by composite (default), delta (biggest gainers), or any quality facet (governance, security, …) to rank providers by that dimension. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal, e.g. ["strong","exemplar"].

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

facet.description: Facet to threshold with min_facet: discoverability, contract_quality, contract_governance, operational_transparency, developer_ergonomics, access_clarity.

max_score.description: Only ratings at or below this composite. Pair with min_score for a range.

min_facet.description: Minimum score on `facet` (0-100); ignored without `facet`. E.g. 70.

min_score.description: Only providers whose Kin Score composite is at or above this, 0-100, e.g. 60.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

providers.description: Restrict to these provider slugs — the ratings of a named set.

tags.description: Tag slugs the provider carries, e.g. ["payments"].

trend.description: Week-over-week movement: "rising" (+5 or more), "falling" (-5 or more) or "flat" (within 5).

name: find_ratings
